slides.sub: Why a planet's sign is only half the story.

slides.body: A planet in its own or exalted sign is usually read as strong. That is the first layer, and many apps stop right here.
Ashtakavarga is a point system. Each planet gets bindus (points) in each sign, from 0 to 8, contributed by the other planets and the Ascendant.
A planet can sit in a friendly sign yet hold few bindus there. Its promise may deliver less than the sign alone suggests.
The reverse also happens. A planet in an ordinary sign with high bindus can quietly perform better than expected.
Sign placement shows the planet's quality. Bindus show how much support it gets in that sign. Together they give a fuller picture.
Neither layer is a verdict. Dasha timing, house and aspects matter too. Use bindus as one more lens on the chart.
Free Ashtakavarga View: see your bindus sign by sign.
